import sys
import time

from gov.retrieval import lexical

root = sys.argv[1]
for term in sys.argv[2:]:
    t = time.time()
    answer = lexical.search(root, term, refresh=False)
    chunks = {hit["chunk_id"] for hit in answer["hits"]}
    print(term, answer["available"], answer["reason"], len(answer["hits"]), len(chunks), round(time.time() - t, 3))
